scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit && echo 'git hooks → .githooks (openapi:check on commit)'
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/assert-desktop-download-messages.mjs && node scripts/assert-listing-honest-limits.mjs && node scripts/assert-notarize-release-tag-default.mjs && npm run verify:desktop-downloads:fixture && npm run verify:desktop-downloads:fixture:notarized-404 && npm run sync:home-continue-stamp:check
scripts.openapi:sync: cp docs/openapi-check-timing.yaml extension/shared/openapi-check-timing.yaml && cp docs/check-timing.schema.json extension/shared/check-timing.schema.json && cp docs/API_CHECK_CONTRACT.md extension/shared/API_CHECK_CONTRACT.md
scripts.openapi:check: cmp -s docs/openapi-check-timing.yaml extension/shared/openapi-check-timing.yaml && cmp -s docs/check-timing.schema.json extension/shared/check-timing.schema.json && cmp -s docs/API_CHECK_CONTRACT.md extension/shared/API_CHECK_CONTRACT.md
scripts.safari:build: xcodebuild -project "safari/Preventive Shield/Preventive Shield.xcodeproj" -scheme "Preventive Shield" -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath "${SAFARI_DERIVED_DATA:-/tmp/ps-safari-dd}" build
scripts.safari:archive: xcodebuild -project "safari/Preventive Shield/Preventive Shield.xcodeproj" -scheme "Preventive Shield" -configuration Release -archivePath "${SAFARI_ARCHIVE:-/tmp/ps-safari.xcarchive}" archive
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run smoke:desktop-scan-resources && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run threat:check && npm run build
scripts.check:desktop: npm run smoke:desktop-proxy-readout && npm run smoke:desktop-install-accept && node scripts/assert-dashboard-no-bare-focus.mjs && node scripts/assert-launcher-quit-preserves-honest-limits.mjs && node scripts/assert-health-monitor-notarized-kind.mjs && node scripts/assert-hint-contrast-aa.mjs && npm run verify:desktop-downloads:fixture && npm run verify:desktop-downloads:fixture:notarized-404 && npm run smoke:desktop-quarantine-i18n && npm run test:playwright:desktop-primary-path-pt && npm run test:playwright:risk-result-desktop-block && npm run smoke:account-token-merge && npm run smoke:staging-magic-link && npm run smoke:account-exchange-e2e && node scripts/append-check-desktop-summary.mjs && tsx --test tests/focus-gate-bare-focus.test.ts tests/spa-replace-state-hashchange.test.ts tests/home-continue-stamp-tag-only.test.ts tests/desktop-reveal-path.test.ts tests/macos-http-proxy-clear.test.ts
scripts.threat:check: npm run threat:validate && npm run regression
scripts.threat:check:help: node -e "const lines=['threat:check exit: 0=ok, 1=invalid curated list or regression fail, 2=cannot read curated file','After PT list changes, npm run evaluate must keep EVAL-029–032 green (MERGE_PT on/off + benign lookalike).']; for (const m of lines) { console.log(m); if (process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS==='true') console.log('::notice::'+m); }"
